topic: Creatine for brain health — beyond muscle performance
caption: Did you know creatine isn't just for athletes? 🏋️‍♀️ It has a profound impact on brain health too! 🧠 Studies show creatine supplementation can improve memory, cognitive function, and even help with neurodegenerative diseases. 📚💡 But how does it work?
